answer: The haven schedule is applied in umber and mesa shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2893 identities would post 4745 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
